name: Soyuz MS-26
about: Soyuz MS-26 (2024-162A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2024 Sep 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Sep 11), held fixed
docked to A07725; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
